_comment: Thresholds for the weekly monitoring job. They are starting values that I checked against the natural month-to-month drift of the BAF data (training months 0-2 vs validation reached a drift share of 0.13-0.23, so 0.25 does not fire on normal variation). min_served_recall = recall of v1 on the validation data when 5.5 % are reviewed (0.593) minus 10 pp; it is fixed, so retraining cannot lower the target. calibration_ratio_band = mean probability / fraud rate outside this band gives a warning.
